title: LegacyImport
description: The import_legacy method's result: what a read-only import of a claude-ledger database copied, or with dryRun would copy (CONTRACT.md: import_legacy).

rev.description: The ledger's rev after the import; unchanged by a dry run or when nothing was new

projects.description: Project rows created, with default settings

baselinesUpdated.description: Baselines the ledger had that the file completed: an inferred version promoted, a missing releaser or note filled in

imports.description: Hashes of pasted blocks, so blocks imported there count as duplicates here

skipped.description: IDs of sessions the ledger already has; neither they nor their events and questions were copied

errors.description: Rows that could not be read, for people; everything else was imported
